cases.prompt: Choose whether to spawn a subagent to name one private helper before the parent edits it.
The parent has established an independent delegated task: rename a private helper, update every reference, and run focused tests. Choose its configuration.
The parent has established an independent delegated task: implement a low-risk endpoint from an adjacent precedent and its tests. Choose its configuration.

The parent has established an independent delegated implementation: propagate request context across twenty modules. The architecture, required behavior, and one authoritative precedent are supplied. Each module exposes a different lifecycle API, so the agent must adapt the established convention across synchronous, asynchronous, retry, cancellation, fan-out, and error paths and update the focused tests. Choose its configuration.

The parent has established an independent delegated security review of one tenant-authorization component. Its API behavior and four authorization invariants are supplied, but the privilege-escalation mechanism is not identified. Analyze three interacting permission flows, identify the mechanism, compare two documented remedies, and produce a focused security-test checklist; the scope stays within this component and no implementation is required. Choose its configuration.

The parent has established an independent delegated adjudication of two conflicting security recommendations for a small authorization-policy diff. The complete diff, security invariants, evidence, and decision rubric are supplied. Return the safer recommendation with a brief rationale; no search or implementation is required. Choose its configuration.
The parent has established an independent delegated review: map an unfamiliar authentication subsystem and identify security risks and trust boundaries. Choose its configuration.
The parent has established an independent delegated architecture review for an irreversible, novel migration spanning storage, identity, and billing. Choose its configuration.
